messages:
Lena (SRE): Postmortem follow-up: recurring tail spikes (p95) + occasional p99s on text-gen in us-west. Pattern = KV eviction + some oversized batches. Need owners, short timelines, and a decision on temporary SLO/SLA adjustments so customer pages stay stable.

Owen: Confirmed traces show KV eviction storms at the same times as the p95 jumps. I can take dashboard work and a heatmap of request sizes. ETA Mon 11:00.

Sara G: We're seeing throughput drops during the same windows; might be correlated. I'll own a lightweight load-shedding experiment and a run of canary traffic shaping (ETA Tue EOD).

Tom - Runtime: I'll add a quick guard to cap batch size at 50 for the next two deploys. Low risk.

Marta Ops: Short SLO proposal: emergency 24h window where p95 target relaxes from 220ms -> 280ms and throughput SLO gets a temporary 5% slack. Pause feature rollouts during the window. Auto-revert if extra error-budget burn >4%. Thoughts?

Lena (SRE): Sounds reasonable as an emergency. Please add the exact wording to the ops runbook. Also add an alert that pages when p95 delta >40ms for 10m and when throughput drops >8% in 10m.

Owen: Adding panels now. Example Grafana alert rule I'll add: ```if (p95 - baseline_p95) > 0.04 and for 10m then page``` Linking rule after push.

ops-bot: ticket created: RED-8015 "us-west text-gen tail spikes - dashboards, batch-cap, temporary SLO slack". Canary scheduled on next deploy.

Sara G: Plan recap: Owen -> dashboards + p95-by-pool heatmap (Mon 11:00), Tom -> batch-cap deploy (today), Sara -> load-shedding experiment (Tue EOD), Marta -> ops runbook + SLO override PR (today 18:00). Reconvene Wed 09:30 to review telemetry and decide permanent SLO edits.

Lena (SRE): Added checklist to RED-8015 and assigned owners. If telemetry still shows reoccurrence after these steps we'll escalate to per-pool throughput quotas and a short A/B rollback of recent model tuning. See you Wed. :calendar:
